content.title: FOODS AND THE ORGANS THEY {{QUIETLY}} SUPPORT
facts: **BEETS** are good for **LIVER** — they contain **betalains** that support the liver's natural detox pathways.
**CARROTS** are good for **EYES** — rich in **beta-carotene**, which the body converts into vitamin A for healthy vision.
**OATS** are good for **GUT LINING** — their **soluble fiber** feeds beneficial bacteria and helps maintain a healthy gut barrier.
**CHERRIES** are good for **JOINTS** — they contain **anthocyanins**, plant compounds linked to lower inflammation around joints.
**CRANBERRIES** are good for **BLADDER** — compounds called **proanthocyanidins** may help stop bacteria from sticking to the bladder wall.
**PUMPKIN SEEDS** are good for **PANCREAS** — they provide **magnesium**, a mineral involved in insulin activity and pancreatic function.
**ARTICHOKES** are good for **GALLBLADDER** — they contain **cynarin**, which may support healthy bile flow.
**WALNUTS** are good for **BRAIN** — a natural source of **omega-3 ALA**, linked to long-term brain health.
